description:
ADR 1.1.3.6 "small load" exemption points for a dangerous-goods road load, and whether it qualifies; points = quantity x the transport category multiplier. The rule (1.1.3.6.2), for dangerous goods carried in packages: goods of ONE transport category qualify when their TOTAL on the transport unit stays within that category's 1.1.3.6.3 column (3) maximum (category 1: 20, 2: 333, 3: 1,000 kg or L; 4 unlimited; 0: 0); goods of DIFFERENT categories qualify when the 1.1.3.6.4 points sum does not exceed 1,000. Transport category 0 can never use the exemption. For limited/excepted quantity relief use adr_lq_eq_check; for a substance's row and variant_index adr_lookup; for the whole ADR picture of a load (tunnels, documents, plates) adr_consignment_check.

Send un_number + quantity for one substance OR items[] for a load — never both: a single-substance field sent beside items[] is refused, never dropped. Quantities are kg or litres per the substance's ADR unit; a quantity of 0 means not carried, and a load of nothing but zeros is refused. A UN number whose Table A rows disagree needs packing_group or variant_index, else that line has no verdict (AMBIGUOUS_UN_VARIANT with candidates[]) — never a guessed row. An ID-prefixed air-only number (e.g. "ID8000") is counted out of 1.1.3.6 only with icao_limited_quantity: true on that line, otherwise BLOCKED. Without that statement the ID line is BLOCKED (items[].entry_required true) and the load has no verdict unless the other lines settle it. A gross mass (basis "gross") is only an upper bound: send the net quantity. edition ("2025" | "2027") and as_of choose the ADR edition; neither sent, ADR 2025 until 2027-01-01. Such an answer headlines the transitional basis that clears the load, names it, gives basis_until (the last day it may be applied) and puts the strict ADR 2027 figure beside it (strict_adr_2027: basis, total_points, exempt, has_category_zero, has_quantity_exceedance). Fields are checked by name: a field the tool does not read is refused with a tool error naming it and listing the accepted ones, never ignored. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets. A calculation over reference data, not legal advice: 1.1.3.6 relieves goods carried in packages only (not in bulk or in tanks), and exempt loads keep core duties; verify against the current UNECE ADR text.

as_of.description: The date the answer is for, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, UTC).

basis.description: net or gross; a gross mass is only an upper bound of the net (figure_basis upper_bound_gross; send the net quantity). Single-substance form only.

consignment.description: The consignment object, instead of the other arguments. Send it alone.

edition.description: ADR edition; wins over as_of. Omitted: as_of picks it.

icao_limited_quantity.description: ID-prefixed un_number only: true states the packages are ICAO Technical Instructions limited quantities (the 3.4.8 mark, or 3.4.10).

basis.description: net or gross; a gross mass is only an upper bound of the net.

icao_limited_quantity.description: OPTIONAL, ID-prefixed lines only: as the top-level icao_limited_quantity.

packing_group.description: Packing group for a multi-variant UN.

quantity.description: Quantity in kg or litres per the substance's ADR unit; 0 = not carried (state EXCLUDED_NIL).

un_number.description: UN number (4 digits, optionally "UN"-prefixed) or an ID-prefixed air-only number ("ID8000").

unit.description: The dimension quantity is stated in, checked against the one ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts for the row (a mismatch gives no points). Omitted: taken as already on that basis.

variant_index.description: ADR Table A variant index for a multi-variant UN.

packing_group.description: Packing group, to pin one row of a multi-row UN. Single-substance form only.

quantity.description: Quantity in kg or litres per the substance's ADR unit. Single-substance form only.

un_number.description: UN number (4 digits, optionally "UN"-prefixed) or an ID-prefixed air-only number ("ID8000"). Single-substance form only.

unit.description: The dimension quantity is stated in, checked against the one ADR 1.1.3.6.3 counts for the row (a mismatch gives no points). Omitted: taken as already on that basis. Single-substance form only.

variant_index.description: ADR Table A variant index (from adr_lookup), to pin one row. Single-substance form only.
